stocks.impact_theory: NVIDIA announced a delay in Blackwell AI chip production due to supply chain issues in Taiwan amid geopolitical tensions. This raises concerns over AI infrastructure buildout pace, echoing the 2021 chip shortage that caused 20% dip in semis. Market psychology shifts to fear of slowed AI capex by hyperscalers. Analogies: 1) Like 2018 crypto winter hitting GPU demand. 2) Supply crunch similar to 2020 COVID toilet paper shortage amplifying scarcity fears.

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Web searches reveal headlines on production delay from TSMC issues; X semantic search shows 70% negative sentiment in latest 20 posts (e.g., 'NVDA bubble popping'), with high engagement on delay rumors. Historical parallels show 5-10% drops on similar news.

potential_profit_risks.long_position: Avoid; potential rebound if delay <3 months, +2-3% short-term bounce
potential_profit_risks.short_position: Short with 5-8% downside target; cover if buy-the-dip rally
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: Unexpected resolution to supply issues, broader market rally, or CEO denial tweet sparking reversal.

stocks.justification: Strong consensus across news and X sentiment, corroborated by historical supply shock reactions.
